title: 15 Degree Wobble Extension
introduction:
A wobble extension gives the socket a little freedom to lean when a straight approach is awkward. I use the drawing to check that lean: the marked angle is between the extension and the fastener’s axis, rather than between the torque-wrench handle and the extension. Think of it as elbow room with a firm boundary.

Use the workshop-manual specification for the fastener and keep within the angular limit stated below. This reference establishes the illustrated tool arrangement; the fastener’s own procedure supplies the rest of the tightening instructions.

items.name: Fastener specification
items.detail: Obtain the tightening specification for the particular fastener from the workshop manual.

items.name: Extension angle
items.detail: Check the extension’s lean against the fastener axis shown in the drawing, and do not exceed the stated limit.
